description: This file defines the GeneralDialogController class, which manages the display and dismissal of dialogs within an Android application. It includes nested interfaces for dialog presentation customization and an internal no-operation implementation.

classes.name: GeneralDialogController
classes.description: Main class responsible for controlling dialog display and dismissal, with customizable presentation via interfaces.

classes.name: GeneralDialogController.DialogPresenter
classes.description: Interface for customizing dialog setup and actions before showing.

classes.name: GeneralDialogController.JustSetupDialogPresenter
classes.description: Interface for setting up dialog content without additional behavior.

classes.name: GeneralDialogController.NoOpImpl
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of DialogPresenter that delegates setup to another presenter.

methods.name: GeneralDialogController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the controller with context, style, and dialog presenter.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the currently shown dialog if any.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with a specified option ID and optional data.
